legal_units.title: Life insurance business
legal_units.text: A.—Life insurance business
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XIV INSURANCE BUSINESS Schedule XIV, Part (A) A.—Life insurance business

legal_units.title: Profits of life insurance business to be computed separately.
legal_units.text: If a person is engaged in life insurance business during the tax year, the profits and gains of such business shall be computed separately from profits and gains of any other business.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XIV INSURANCE BUSINESS Schedule XIV, Part (A), Paragraph (1) If a person is engaged in life insurance business during the tax year, the profits and gains of such business shall be computed separately from profits and gains of any other business.

legal_units.title: Computation of profits of life insurance business.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XIV INSURANCE BUSINESS Schedule XIV, Part (A), Paragraph (2)

legal_units.text: The profits and gains life insurance business shall be the annual average of the surplus after adjusting the surplus or deficit disclosed by the actuarial valuation made as per the Insurance Act, 1938 (4 of 1938) for the last inter-valuation period ending before the commencement of tax year, so as to exclude from it any surplus or deficit from any earlier inter-valuation period.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XIV INSURANCE BUSINESS Schedule XIV, Part (A), Paragraph (2), Subparagraph (1) The profits and gains life insurance business shall be the annual average of the surplus after adjusting the surplus or deficit disclosed by the actuarial valuation made as per the Insurance Act, 1938 (4 of 1938) for the last inter-valuation period ending before the commencement of tax year, so as to exclude from it any surplus or deficit from any earlier inter-valuation period.

legal_units.text: Any expenditure which is inadmissible under section 34 in computing the profits and gains of a business, shall be added to such profits and gains of life insurance business.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XIV INSURANCE BUSINESS Schedule XIV, Part (A), Paragraph (2), Subparagraph (2) Any expenditure which is inadmissible under section 34 in computing the profits and gains of a business, shall be added to such profits and gains of life insurance business.

legal_units.title: Other insurance business
legal_units.text: B.—Other insurance business
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XIV INSURANCE BUSINESS Schedule XIV, Part (B) B.—Other insurance business

legal_units.title: Computation of profits and gains of other insurance business.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XIV INSURANCE BUSINESS Schedule XIV, Part (B), Paragraph (4)

legal_units.text: The profits and gains of any insurance business other than life insurance shall be the profit before tax and appropriations as disclosed in the profit and loss account prepared as per the Insurance Act, 1938 (4 of 1938) or the rules made thereunder or the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999 (4 of 1999) or the regulations made subject to the following adjustments:--

legal_units.title: Other provisions
legal_units.text: C.—Other provisions
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XIV INSURANCE BUSINESS Schedule XIV, Part (C) C.—Other provisions

legal_units.title: Profits and gains of non-resident person.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XIV INSURANCE BUSINESS Schedule XIV, Part (C), Paragraph (5)

legal_units.text: The profits and gains of a person non-resident in India who is engaged in the insurance business through its branches in India may, in the absence of more reliable data, be deemed to be that proportion of his global income which corresponds to the proportion which his premium income derived from India bears to his total premium income.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XIV INSURANCE BUSINESS Schedule XIV, Part (C), Paragraph (5), Subparagraph (1) The profits and gains of a person non-resident in India who is engaged in the insurance business through its branches in India may, in the absence of more reliable data, be deemed to be that proportion of his global income which corresponds to the proportion which his premium income derived from India bears to his total premium income.

legal_units.text: In this paragraph, the global income in relation to life insurance business of a person not resident in India shall be computed as per this Act for computing the profits and gains of life Insurance business carried on in India.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XIV INSURANCE BUSINESS Schedule XIV, Part (C), Paragraph (5), Subparagraph (2) In this paragraph, the global income in relation to life insurance business of a person not resident in India shall be computed as per this Act for computing the profits and gains of life Insurance business carried on in India.

legal_units.citation: Schedule XIV, Part (C), Paragraph (6), Subparagraph (1), Clause (a)
legal_units.text: "investments" include securities, stocks and shares;

legal_units.citation: Schedule XIV, Part (C), Paragraph (6), Subparagraph (1), Clause (b)
legal_units.text: "life insurance business" means life insurance business as defined in section 2(11) of the Insurance Act, 1938 (4 of 1938).

legal_units.text: References to the Insurance Act, 1938 (4 of 1938) in this Schedule regarding the Life Insurance Corporation of India shall be treated as references to that Act or section 43 of the Life Insurance Corporation Act, 1956 (31 of 1956).
